name: Gakuen Taimaden Reiko
source:
An adventure game staring a brown-haired japanese schoolgirl and her various lesbian adventures. It appears to be pretty linear.

[Edited From PC98.ORG]

In order to investigate an incident happened at a girl's school the heroine transfers there as a student. Upon arrival she feels being watched and the only student she meets runs away from her in fear...

[From kivandopulus' VNDBReview blog]
